Title: experiment0
AltText: I have to separate
Description:
Two small experimental water color drawings (both A5) I did in one evening. They are only together in one image because I scanned them together in order to save me some time. Unfortunately I was to lazy to separate them afterwards. So now there are two totally independant drawings stuck together. Oh well. 
 
The one on the left was inspired my a halloween costume of one of my bestfriends. The one on the right was a redrawing of a doodle I did in my sketchbook on a train ride. It's inspired by the song "TV Head" by Elliot Lee. Back then it kind of resembled on how I felt for a while. Thankfully it was a short period of my life. I have made a bigger (A3) watercolor grawing later on.

Title: Sleepover
Description:
..."Would you...", the words stuck in his throat for a moment, "would you mind letting me sleep in your room, tonight?" The pillow he brought with him felt like a rescue rope he held tight to his chest. His face felt like it was burning and he hoped she was to tired to notice his embarrassment.

"Please?" He was expecting a solid no as an answer.

For a moment, she didn't respond. Her face went from one expression to another. She mustered him up and down, like the security at the airport would do. Clisty let out a long sight before fully opening the door and letting him in...

But I wanted to do a pair, that hasn't seen much stagelight so far. So here we have Aquavia and Pyjama Man. Also I am very proud of how well I drew the apple owo.

Title: Mirror
Description: ...When Bryan opened his eyes again, his breath got caught in his throat. A pair of magenta eyes stared from the mirror back at him. Everything of his face was the same. But his eye color was different. The mirror was shaking in his hands. His reflection started to grin. Blood dripping from it's mouth, just like in that one night over a year ago. Did he always have this sharp teeth?...

Title: Past Lives
Description: Inspired by the Song "Past Lives". The version of Borns was the one I stumbled across first. Hearing this song really gave me a sense of nostagia and longing of a lost love. And then I though "Hey, what if Bryan met Clisty before they ended in the middle of nowhere?" So I decided he might have worked in a flowershop just across the street from her tea shop. And then I had this image in mind.
